scope: Configurable tmux viewer keyboard and mouse input on disposable fixtures

cases.input: SGR mouse click on pane 2, then typed unique marker and Enter
Same SGR mouse click and typed unique marker

ordinary_tmux_pty.isolation: Each policy used a fresh private tmux server, socket, two-pane session and reader processes; mouse was enabled only on that disposable session.

first_bounded_sdk_attempt.mapped_pane_resolution: failed within 8 seconds using the initial raw window-ID comparison

mapped_pane.input_method: iTerm2 SDK async_send_text on the exact mapped pane

earlier_gateway_probe.detail: The iTerm connector marker was sent to Viewer.open's outer Control Mode gateway session. The pane sink did not record it; the target was not confirmed as an iTerm mapped pane.

iterm2_native.hide_reopen_policy_change: hide was verified; reopening with the opposite policy was not reached after close returned unknown

cleanup.residual_shell_note: An idle -zsh session 32F3AC8D-EF70-4E85-A6DD-35A7DD3170C5 appeared in a new iTerm window after the interrupted probe. Its screen showed only a fresh login line and empty prompt, but its window/tab was not directly bound to the original viewer receipt. It was closed by sending exit based on the before/after session inventory; this cleanup was not receipt-bound. The iTerm inventory returned to its original 13 sessions.

limitations: The corrected native run verified mapped GUI input with allow_input=true only. The allow_input=false mapped-pane case remains unverified because the harness stopped after exact-session close returned unknown.
The initial SDK run used an unnormalized window ID and did not identify the mapped pane; it sent no input. The earlier outer-gateway probe is not valid mapped-input evidence.
Native mapped mouse input was not verified.
The PTY acceptance verifies tmux client behavior on one macOS host and tmux 3.6a; it does not verify Terminal.app or other tmux releases.
